_comment: Template for config.json. Either copy this file to config.json next to it and fill in the values by hand, or run `python scripts/cpd_init.py`, which verifies the credentials and discovers space/project/deployment IDs for you. A config.json here is read before ~/.config/cpd-onprem/config.json, so a checkout can be self-contained; it is git-ignored and must stay that way, because it will hold your API key. $CPD_CONFIG overrides both. Every value can also come from an environment variable (CPD_URL, CPD_USERNAME, CPD_API_KEY, CPD_SPACE_ID, CPD_PROJECT_ID, CPD_DEPLOYMENT_ID, CPD_WXO_INSTANCE_URL, CPD_VERIFY_SSL), which takes precedence over any file.
